(zag: e2e/tour.e2e.ts: "keyboard navigation")
- Given `keyboardNavigation` is false, when ArrowRight is pressed, then the tour stays on the first step. (zag: e2e/tour.e2e.ts: "[no keyboard navigation] should do not advance")
- The content key map advances on ArrowRight and retreats on ArrowLeft, swapping the two in RTL. (zag: packages/machines/tour/src/tour.connect.ts)

### Pointer

- Given the tour page, when Start is clicked, then the content appears and the first step is centered in the viewport. (zag: e2e/tour.e2e.ts: "should open tour on click start")

### Dismissal and layering

- Given an open tour, when Escape is pressed, then the tour closes. (zag: e2e/tour.e2e.ts: "should close on escape")

### Positioning

- The spotlight-should-surround-the-target case is marked fixme because of an offset bug, so spotlight geometry is not actually verified. (zag: e2e/tour.e2e.ts: "should align with spotlight (due to offset)")

### Notes and edge cases

- Both `preventInteraction` cases are marked fixme, so neither blocking nor allowing text selection on the highlighted target is verified. (zag: e2e/tour.e2e.ts: "[preventInteraction=true] should not allow interacting with target"; zag: e2e/tour.e2e.ts: "[preventInteraction=false] should allow interacting with target")
- The keyboard-navigation spec intercepts `https://api.github.com/users/octocat` with a stubbed response, so the data-fetching step does not hit the network. (zag: e2e/tour.e2e.ts: "keyboard navigation")
- The tour model deliberately asserts visibility rather than `toBeInViewport`, because auto-scroll settling made viewport assertions flaky. (zag: e2e/models/tour.model.ts)
- No Ark framework package ships a tour test, so the tour contract is pinned only by the Zag e2e spec. (zag: e2e/tour.e2e.ts)

## floating-panel

### Roles and attributes

- Anatomy parts are trigger, positioner, content, header, body, title, resizeTrigger, dragTrigger, stageTrigger, closeTrigger, control. (zag: packages/machines/floating-panel/src/floating-panel.anatomy.ts)
- The trigger is `type="button"` with `aria-controls` on the content id, `data-state` and `data-dragging`. (zag: packages/machines/floating-panel/src/floating-panel.connect.ts)
- The positioner sets `--width`, `--height`, `--x`, `--y` and `--z-index` (derived from the panel's index in the stack) and consumes them via `zIndex: var(--z-index)`. (zag: packages/machines/floating-panel/src/floating-panel.connect.ts)
- The content is `role="dialog"` with `tabIndex={0}`, `hidden` while closed, `aria-labelledby` on the title, and the attributes `data-state`, `data-dragging`, `data-topmost`, `data-behind`, `data-minimized`, `data-maximized` and `data-staged`. (zag: packages/machines/floating-panel/src/floating-panel.connect.ts)
- Stage triggers are `type="button"` with `data-stage` naming their target stage; minimize and maximize are hidden while the panel is already staged, and restore is hidden while it is not. (zag: packages/machines/floating-panel/src/floating-panel.connect.ts)
- Resize triggers carry `data-axis` for each of the eight directions and `data-disabled` when resizing is off; the drag trigger carries `data-disabled` when dragging is off; the close trigger is a button labelled "Close Window". (zag: packages/machines/floating-panel/src/floating-panel.connect.ts)

### Keyboard

- Given an open panel, when Escape is pressed, then the panel closes. (zag: e2e/floating-panel.e2e.ts: "should close panel on escape")
- The content key map moves the panel by a step with ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, ArrowUp and ArrowDown, so a panel can be repositioned from the keyboard. (zag: packages/machines/floating-panel/src/floating-panel.connect.ts)

### Pointer

- Given the trigger is clicked, then the panel content appears, and clicking the close trigger hides it. (zag: e2e/floating-panel.e2e.ts: "should open and close panel"; ark: packages/solid/src/components/floating-panel/tests/floating-panel.test.tsx: "should show panel content when opened")
- Given an open panel, when minimize is clicked, then the content reports `data-minimized` and the body is hidden, and clicking restore brings the body back. (zag: e2e/floating-panel.e2e.ts: "should minimize and restore panel")
- Given an open panel, when maximize is clicked, then the content reports `data-maximized`, and restore returns it to its original position and size within 8px. (zag: e2e/floating-panel.e2e.ts: "should maximize and restore panel")
- Given a minimized panel, when the title bar is double-clicked, then the panel restores rather than maximizing. (zag: e2e/floating-panel.e2e.ts: "should restore when double-clicking title while minimized")
- Given a maximized panel, when the title bar is double-clicked, then the panel restores. (zag: e2e/floating-panel.e2e.ts: "should restore when double-clicking title while maximized")
- Given a panel in its default stage, when the title bar is double-clicked, then the panel maximizes. (zag: e2e/floating-panel.e2e.ts: "should maximize when double-clicking title in default state")
- Given a minimized panel, when it is restored by double-click, then its size matches the original size before minimizing. (zag: e2e/floating-panel.e2e.ts: "should restore to original size after minimize → double-click → restore flow")
- Given the controlled example and a panel dragged by (140, 90), when it is maximized and then restored, then it returns to the dragged position within 8px. (zag: e2e/floating-panel.e2e.ts: "should restore to previous position after maximize in controlled page")
- Given an open panel, when a drag is started and Escape is pressed mid-drag before release, then the position reverts to the original within 8px. (zag: e2e/floating-panel.e2e.ts: "should revert position when pressing escape during drag")
- Given an open panel, when a resize is started from the bottom-right corner and Escape is pressed mid-resize, then the size reverts to the original within 8px. (zag: e2e/floating-panel.e2e.ts: "should revert size when pressing escape during resize")
- Given an onOpenChange handler on an open panel, when Close is clicked, then it fires exactly once. (ark: packages/solid/src/components/floating-panel/tests/floating-panel.test.tsx: "should invoke onOpenChange if panel is closed")

### Focus management

- Given panels A then B are opened, when panel A's content is focused, then A gains `data-topmost` and its positioner's computed z-index becomes greater than B's. (zag: e2e/floating-panel.e2e.ts: "focusing a panel raises its positioner above the other panels")

### State and controlled/uncontrolled

- Given the controlled example declares both a controlled `open` and a `defaultOpen`, then the panel starts closed because the controlled value wins, and clicking the trigger opens it. (zag: e2e/floating-panel.e2e.ts: "should prefer controlled open over defaultOpen on initialization")
- Given the controlled example, when the "API set position: (48, 48)" and "API set size: 440x300" buttons are clicked, then the panel moves and resizes to those exact values within 10px, proving `api.setPosition` and `api.setSize`. (zag: e2e/floating-panel.e2e.ts: "should support api.setPosition and api.setSize in controlled page")

### Dismissal and layering

- Given panels A then B are open, then B has `data-topmost=""` and A has `data-behind=""`; when B is closed, A becomes topmost and B loses the attribute. (zag: e2e/floating-panel.e2e.ts: "closing the topmost panel promotes the next panel to topmost")

### Animation and presence

- Given `lazyMount`, then the positioner is absent until the panel first opens and stays mounted after closing, and the trigger has no `aria-controls` in that state. (ark: packages/solid/src/components/floating-panel/tests/floating-panel.test.tsx: "should be able to lazy mount"; ark: packages/solid/src/components/floating-panel/tests/floating-panel.test.tsx: "should not have aria-controls if lazy mounted")
- Given `lazyMount` with `unmountOnExit`, then the positioner is removed after the panel closes. (ark: packages/solid/src/components/floating-panel/tests/floating-panel.test.tsx: "should lazy mount and unmount on exit")

### Accessibility tooling

- Given an open floating panel, when axe runs over the `[role=dialog]` subtree, then there are no violations. (zag: e2e/floating-panel.e2e.ts: "should have no accessibility violation")

### Notes and edge cases

- Given the controlled example, when five cycles of resize-out, resize-in and drag are performed, then the ResizeObserver readout stays visible and no "Maximum update depth exceeded" message appears in the console within 1.5s, pinning a controlled-state feedback loop regression. (zag: e2e/floating-panel.e2e.ts: "should not report maximum update depth errors when resizing controlled page")
- Solid is the only Ark framework with floating-panel tests. (ark: packages/solid/src/components/floating-panel/tests/floating-panel.test.tsx)

## menu

### Roles and attributes

- Anatomy parts are arrow, arrowTip, content, contextTrigger, indicator, item, itemGroup, itemGroupLabel, itemIndicator, itemText, positioner, separator, trigger, triggerItem. (zag: packages/machines/menu/src/menu.anatomy.ts)
- The content is `role="menu"` when composite (the default) and `role="dialog"` otherwise, with `tabIndex={0}`, `hidden` while closed, `data-state`, `data-placement`, `data-side`, an optional `aria-label`, `aria-activedescendant` naming the highlighted item, and `aria-labelledby` pointing at the trigger unless an anchor point is used. (zag: packages/machines/menu/src/menu.connect.ts)
- Focus lives on the content element itself and the highlighted item is tracked with `aria-activedescendant` plus `data-highlighted`, not by moving DOM focus onto items. (zag: packages/machines/menu/src/menu.connect.ts; zag: e2e/menu.e2e.ts: "on arrow up and down, change highlighted item")
- Each item is `role="menuitem"` with `aria-disabled`, `data-disabled`, `data-ownedby` set to the content id, `data-highlighted`, `data-value` and `data-valuetext` (the typeahead text). (zag: packages/machines/menu/src/menu.connect.ts)
- Option items take `role="menuitemradio"` or `role="menuitemcheckbox"` from their type, plus `aria-checked`, `data-type`, `data-value` and `data-state` of checked/unchecked. (zag: packages/machines/menu/src/menu.connect.ts)
- The item indicator and item text carry `data-disabled`, `data-highlighted` and, for option items, `data-state`; the indicator is `hidden` when its `checked` prop is false. (zag: packages/machines/menu/src/menu.connect.ts)
- The item group is `role="group"` with `aria-labelledby` on its label id; the separator is `role="separator"` with `aria-orientation="horizontal"`. (zag: packages/machines/menu/src/menu.connect.ts)
- The trigger is `type="button"` with `aria-haspopup` of `menu` (or `dialog` when not composite), `aria-controls` and a mirrored `data-controls` on the content id, `aria-expanded`, `data-state`, `data-placement`, `data-side`, `data-uid`, and for multi-trigger setups `data-ownedby`, `data-value` and `data-current`. (zag: packages/machines/menu/src/menu.connect.ts)
- The context trigger carries `data-ownedby`, `data-value`, `data-current` and `data-state`, and starts a long-press timer on touch pointerdown that is cancelled by pointermove, pointercancel or pointerup. (zag: packages/machines/menu/src/menu.connect.ts)
- A submenu trigger item is produced by `getTriggerItemProps(childApi)`, which merges the child menu's trigger props with item props so one element is both a menuitem and a trigger. (zag: packages/machines/menu/src/menu.connect.ts)
- With multiple triggers, `aria-expanded` is true only on the active trigger and false on the rest, and only the active trigger carries `data-current=""`. (zag: e2e/menu-multiple-trigger.e2e.ts: "should scope aria-expanded to active trigger"; zag: e2e/menu-multiple-trigger.e2e.ts: "should set data-current on active trigger only")
- With multiple context triggers, only the right-clicked trigger carries `data-current=""`. (zag: e2e/context-menu-multiple-trigger.e2e.ts: "should set data-current on the active trigger")
- Given a disabled menu item, then it exposes `aria-disabled="true"`. (ark: packages/react/src/components/menu/tests/menu.test.tsx: "should set correct aria attributes on disabled MenuItems"; ark: packages/solid/src/components/menu/tests/menu.test.tsx: "should set correct aria attributes on disabled MenuItems"; ark: packages/vue/src/components/menu/tests/menu.test.ts: "should set correct aria attributes on disabled MenuItems")
- Given two MenuItemGroups, then exactly two elements expose `role="group"`. (ark: packages/react/src/components/menu/tests/menu.test.tsx: "should apply correct role to MenuItemGroup"; ark: packages/solid/src/components/menu/tests/menu.test.tsx: "should apply correct role to MenuItemGroup"; ark: packages/vue/src/components/menu/tests/menu.test.ts: "should apply correct role to MenuItemGroup")
- Given `lazyMount`, then the trigger carries no `aria-controls`; Vue skips this case. (ark: packages/react/src/components/menu/tests/menu.test.tsx: "should not have aria-controls if lazy mounted"; ark: packages/solid/src/components/menu/tests/menu.test.tsx: "should not have aria-controls if lazy mounted"; ark: packages/vue/src/components/menu/tests/menu.test.ts: "should not have aria-controls if lazy mounted")

### Keyboard

- Given an open menu, when ArrowDown is pressed twice then ArrowUp once, then the highlight moves down two items and back up one. (zag: e2e/menu.e2e.ts: "on arrow up and down, change highlighted item")
- Given an open menu, when "E" is typed, then the first item starting with E is highlighted, and typing "E" again cycles to the next E item. (zag: e2e/menu.e2e.ts: "on typeahead, highlight matching item")
- Given an open menu, when ArrowDown then Enter are pressed, then the highlighted item is selected and the menu closes. (zag: e2e/menu.e2e.ts: "with keyboard, can select item")
- Given `closeOnSelect` is false, when an item is selected with Enter, then the menu stays open. (zag: e2e/menu.e2e.ts: "when closeOnSelect=false, stay open on selection")
- Given a focused trigger, when Enter is pressed, then the menu opens with the content focused, and Enter again selects the first radio option. (zag: e2e/menu-option.e2e.ts: "keyboard, should check/uncheck radio item")
- Given the options menu, when ArrowDown is pressed three times and Enter selects the "Email" checkbox item, then it becomes checked, and reopening and selecting "Phone" leaves both checked. (zag: e2e/menu-option.e2e.ts: "keyboard, should check/uncheck checkbox item")
- Given a focused trigger in a multi-trigger list, when Enter or Space is pressed, then the menu opens showing that trigger's value. (zag: e2e/menu-multiple-trigger.e2e.ts: "should open menu with Enter key"; zag: e2e/menu-multiple-trigger.e2e.ts: "should open menu with Space key")
- Given an open context menu, when ArrowDown is pressed three times, then the fourth item is highlighted. (zag: e2e/context-menu.e2e.ts: "keyboard navigation works")
- The content key map wires ArrowDown, ArrowUp, ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, Enter, Home, End and printable characters into typeahead, and the trigger itself maps ArrowDown, ArrowUp, Enter and Space to open-and-highlight. (zag: packages/machines/menu/src/menu.connect.ts)

- Given the nested menu example, when the submenu trigger is reached by pressing ArrowDown four times, then the submenu stays closed - moving focus onto a submenu trigger does not open it. (zag: e2e/menu-nested.e2e.ts: "open submenu when moving focus to trigger")
- Given focus on a submenu trigger, when Space is pressed, then the submenu opens, takes focus and its trigger stays highlighted. (zag: e2e/menu-nested.e2e.ts: "open submenu with space")
- Given focus on a submenu trigger, when Enter is pressed, then the submenu opens and takes focus. (zag: e2e/menu-nested.e2e.ts: "open submenu with enter")
- Given focus on a submenu trigger, when ArrowRight is pressed, then the submenu opens and takes focus. (zag: e2e/menu-nested.e2e.ts: "open submenu with arrow right")
- Given an open submenu, when ArrowLeft is pressed, then the submenu closes and focus returns to the parent menu. (zag: e2e/menu-nested.e2e.ts: "close submenu with arrow left")
- Given the parent menu is open, when "n" is typed, then the first n-item is highlighted, typing "n" again cycles to the next, and typing the multi-character prefix "new w" highlights the item matching that whole string. (zag: e2e/menu-nested.e2e.ts: "parent menu")
- Given the parent menu is open, when "m" highlights the submenu trigger and Enter opens the submenu, then typing "s" inside the submenu highlights its own matching item, so typeahead is scoped per menu. (zag: e2e/menu-nested.e2e.ts: "nested menu")
- Given three levels of menus opened by keyboard, when Enter selects an item in the third menu, then every menu in the chain closes and focus returns to the root trigger. (zag: e2e/menu-nested.e2e.ts: "using keyboard")

### Pointer

- Given a closed menu, when the trigger is clicked, then it opens; clicking again closes it; clicking a third time reopens it. (zag: e2e/menu.e2e.ts: "click trigger to toggle menu")
- Given an open menu with a hovered item, when the pointer leaves the menu, then no item is highlighted any more. (zag: e2e/menu.e2e.ts: "hover out, clear highlighted item")
- Given the options menu, when "Ascending" is clicked, then the menu closes and that radio item is checked; selecting "Descending" afterwards checks it and unchecks "Ascending". (zag: e2e/menu.e2e.ts: "mouse, should check/uncheck radio item"; zag: e2e/menu-option.e2e.ts: "mouse, should check/uncheck radio item")
- Given the options menu, when the "Email" checkbox item is clicked and then "Phone", then both remain checked, unlike radio items. (zag: e2e/menu-option.e2e.ts: "mouse, should check/uncheck checkbox item")
- Given a multi-trigger menu open from the last trigger, when another trigger is clicked, then the menu stays open and its content swaps to that trigger's value. (zag: e2e/menu-multiple-trigger.e2e.ts: "should switch triggers while menu is open")
- Given a multi-trigger menu, when an item is clicked, then the menu closes. (zag: e2e/menu-multiple-trigger.e2e.ts: "should close menu on item selection")
- Given a menu opened from trigger 1, then the content is visible and focused. (zag: e2e/menu-multiple-trigger.e2e.ts: "should open menu from trigger")
- Given the React or Solid example, when a radio option item is clicked, then it reports `aria-checked="true"`; Vue skips this case. (ark: packages/react/src/components/menu/tests/menu.test.tsx: "should select a radio option"; ark: packages/solid/src/components/menu/tests/menu.test.tsx: "should select a radio option"; ark: packages/vue/src/components/menu/tests/menu.test.ts: "should select a radio option")
- Given the menu is open, when a submenu trigger item is clicked, then the submenu content appears; Vue skips this case. (ark: packages/react/src/components/menu/tests/menu.test.tsx: "should open on nested menu"; ark: packages/solid/src/components/menu/tests/menu.test.tsx: "should open on nested menu"; ark: packages/vue/src/components/menu/tests/menu.test.ts: "should open on nested menu")
- Given a disabled item, when it is clicked, then onValueChange never fires; Vue asserts this by checking that no `valueChange` event was emitted at all. (ark: packages/react/src/components/menu/tests/menu.test.tsx: "should not fire onValueChange on disabled MenuItems"; ark: packages/solid/src/components/menu/tests/menu.test.tsx: "should not fire onValueChange on disabled MenuItems"; ark: packages/vue/src/components/menu/tests/menu.test.ts: "should not fire onValueChange on disabled MenuItems")

- Given the nested menu example with a submenu open by hover, when the pointer moves diagonally from the submenu trigger toward the submenu content, crossing the sibling item directly below the trigger, then the trigger stays highlighted and the submenu stays open - the safe travel area between trigger and submenu is honored. (zag: e2e/menu-nested.e2e.ts: "should keep trigger highlighted when moving pointer toward submenu across sibling items")
- Given a submenu opened by hovering its trigger, then the submenu content is visible and focused, its trigger is highlighted, and no item inside the submenu has `data-focus`, so opening by hover does not preselect the first item. (zag: e2e/menu-nested.e2e.ts: "should open submenu and not focus first item")
- Given a submenu open, when the pointer moves into the submenu, on to another parent item, and back to the submenu trigger, then both the parent menu and the submenu remain open. (zag: e2e/menu-nested.e2e.ts: "should not close when moving pointer to submenu and back to parent trigger")
- Given a submenu open, when the pointer moves to a point left of the trigger and outside both menus, then the submenu closes and the parent menu regains focus. (zag: e2e/menu-nested.e2e.ts: "should close submenu when moving pointer away")
- Given a submenu open, when the pointer moves onto a different parent menu item and an extra pointermove is dispatched, then the submenu closes, the parent menu stays open and focused, and the hovered parent item becomes highlighted. (zag: e2e/menu-nested.e2e.ts: "should close open submenu when moving pointer to parent menu item")
- Given three levels of menus opened by hover, when a leaf item is clicked, then all menus close and focus returns to the root trigger. (zag: e2e/menu-nested.e2e.ts: "using pointer click")

### Focus management

- Given the menu is opened by clicking the trigger, then the content element takes focus rather than any individual item. (zag: e2e/menu.e2e.ts: "with keyboard, can select item")
- Given a multi-trigger menu opened from trigger 3, when Escape is pressed, then the menu closes and focus returns to trigger 3. (zag: e2e/menu-multiple-trigger.e2e.ts: "should close menu on escape and focus active trigger")
- Given focus moved from trigger 1 to trigger 2 by Tab before opening, when Escape closes the menu, then focus returns to trigger 2. (zag: e2e/menu-multiple-trigger.e2e.ts: "should return focus to correct trigger after keyboard navigation")

- Given a parent menu with a submenu trigger hovered, when the pointer moves to the page corner and a click lands outside, then every menu closes and focus returns to the root trigger. (zag: e2e/menu-nested.e2e.ts: "clicking outside or blur")

### State and controlled/uncontrolled

- Given `open` (or `defaultOpen` in Vue), then the menu content is visible on first render. (ark: packages/react/src/components/menu/tests/menu.test.tsx: "should control the open state"; ark: packages/solid/src/components/menu/tests/menu.test.tsx: "should control the open state"; ark: packages/vue/src/components/menu/tests/menu.test.ts: "should control the open state")

### Dismissal and layering

- Given an open menu, when a click lands outside, then the menu closes. (zag: e2e/menu.e2e.ts: "on click outside, close menu")
- Given an open context menu, when Escape is pressed, then it closes. (zag: e2e/context-menu.e2e.ts: "should open on right click"; zag: e2e/context-menu-multiple-trigger.e2e.ts: "should close menu on escape")
- Given an open context menu, when the trigger is left-clicked, then the menu closes. (zag: e2e/context-menu-multiple-trigger.e2e.ts: "should close menu on left-click")

### Positioning

- Given a multi-trigger menu opened from the last trigger, when the first trigger is clicked, then the positioner's Y coordinate decreases. (zag: e2e/menu-multiple-trigger.e2e.ts: "should reposition menu when switching triggers")
- Given a context menu open from trigger 1, when trigger 2 is right-clicked, then the menu stays open, stays focused and its positioner moves to new coordinates. (zag: e2e/context-menu-multiple-trigger.e2e.ts: "should switch triggers and reposition on right-click")
- Given `positioning={{ placement: 'left-start' }}`, then the open menu carries `data-placement="left-start"`; Vue skips this case. (ark: packages/react/src/components/menu/tests/menu.test.tsx: "should accept a custom placement"; ark: packages/solid/src/components/menu/tests/menu.test.tsx: "should accept a custom placement"; ark: packages/vue/src/components/menu/tests/menu.test.ts: "should accept a custom placement")

### Animation and presence

- Given `lazyMount`, then the positioner is absent until the first open and stays mounted after closing. (ark: packages/react/src/components/menu/tests/menu.test.tsx: "should be able to lazy mount"; ark: packages/solid/src/components/menu/tests/menu.test.tsx: "should be able to lazy mount"; ark: packages/vue/src/components/menu/tests/menu.test.ts: "should be able to lazy mount")
- Given `lazyMount` with `unmountOnExit`, then the positioner is removed again after close; Vue skips this case. (ark: packages/react/src/components/menu/tests/menu.test.tsx: "should lazy mount and unmount on exit"; ark: packages/solid/src/components/menu/tests/menu.test.tsx: "should lazy mount and unmount on exit"; ark: packages/vue/src/components/menu/tests/menu.test.ts: "should lazy mount and unmount on exit")

### Accessibility tooling

- Given the basic menu, when axe runs over `main`, then there are no violations. (zag: e2e/menu.e2e.ts: "should have no accessibility violation"; ark: packages/react/src/components/menu/tests/menu.test.tsx: "should have no a11y violations")

### Notes and edge cases

- Given a long menu that scrolls, when an item is hovered and then typeahead jumps to "Zebra", then the highlight follows the typeahead rather than the item now sitting under the unmoved cursor, and the matched item is scrolled into the content viewport. (zag: e2e/menu.e2e.ts: "on typeahead, keep highlight when scroll moves content under the cursor")
- Given a scrolling menu with a hovered item, when End is pressed, then the last item is highlighted and scrolled into view even though the pointer has not moved. (zag: e2e/menu.e2e.ts: "on end key, keep highlight when scroll moves content under the cursor")
- Given the highlight was moved by keyboard after a scroll, when the pointer is then moved onto a different item, then hover regains control of the highlight. (zag: e2e/menu.e2e.ts: "after keyboard scroll, hover still moves the highlight")
- Given an example whose content element is kept mounted while closed and re-parented into a portal on open, when the trigger is clicked, then the menu stays open and the open log reads `open:true`, pinning a dismissable-layer bug where the soon-to-be-detached node was resolved. (zag: e2e/menu-conditional-portal.e2e.ts: "should stay open when the content is re-parented on open")
- Given the re-parented content, when the first item is clicked, then the log records `open:true,select:edit,open:false` in order. (zag: e2e/menu-conditional-portal.e2e.ts: "should select an item in the re-parented content")
- Given the re-parented content, when Escape is pressed, then the reported open state becomes false. (zag: e2e/menu-conditional-portal.e2e.ts: "should close on escape")
- Given a multi-context-trigger page, when a folder row is right-clicked, then the menu's open item reads "Open Folder", and right-clicking a file row instead reads "Open File", so item content is derived from the active trigger. (zag: e2e/context-menu-multiple-trigger.e2e.ts: "should reflect trigger data in menu content")

## context-menu

### Roles and attributes

- The context menu is the same menu machine driven through `getContextTriggerProps`; the trigger carries `data-ownedby`, `data-value`, `data-current` and `data-state`. (zag: packages/machines/menu/src/menu.connect.ts)

### Keyboard

- Given an open context menu, when ArrowDown is pressed three times, then the fourth item is highlighted, so keyboard navigation works identically to a dropdown menu. (zag: e2e/context-menu.e2e.ts: "keyboard navigation works")

### Pointer

- Given the context-menu example, when the trigger is right-clicked, then the menu opens and the content takes focus. (zag: e2e/context-menu.e2e.ts: "should open on right click"; zag: e2e/context-menu-multiple-trigger.e2e.ts: "should open menu on right-click")
- Given an open context menu, when the trigger is left-clicked at the same coordinates and then right-clicked again, then the menu closes and reopens with valid `--x` and `--y` positioner variables, pinning the case where an identical pointer position could skip repositioning. (zag: e2e/context-menu.e2e.ts: "should reposition when right-clicking at same coordinates")
- Given a touch pointerdown held on the trigger, then the long-press timer opens the menu after about 700ms with its positioner within 24px of the touch point. (zag: e2e/context-menu.e2e.ts: "should open at the touch point on long-press")
- Given the React or Solid example, when a contextmenu event fires on the context trigger, then the menu content appears; Vue skips this case. (ark: packages/react/src/components/menu/tests/menu.test.tsx: "should open on context menu"; ark: packages/solid/src/components/menu/tests/menu.test.tsx: "should open on context menu"; ark: packages/vue/src/components/menu/tests/menu.test.ts: "should open on context menu")

## navigation-menu

### Roles and attributes

- Anatomy parts are root, viewportPositioner, viewport, trigger, content, list, item, link, indicator, itemIndicator, arrow. (zag: packages/machines/navigation-menu/src/navigation-menu.anatomy.ts)
- The root carries a translated `aria-label`, `data-orientation`, and the CSS variables `--trigger-width`, `--trigger-height`, `--trigger-x`, `--trigger-y`, `--viewport-width`, `--viewport-height`, `--viewport-x` and `--viewport-y`, which is how the sliding viewport animation is driven. (zag: packages/machines/navigation-menu/src/navigation-menu.connect.ts)
- The list and item parts carry `data-orientation`; item adds `data-value`, `data-state` of open/closed and `data-disabled`. (zag: packages/machines/navigation-menu/src/navigation-menu.connect.ts)
- The trigger is `type="button"` with `aria-controls` on the content id, `aria-expanded`, `data-value`, `data-state`, `data-disabled`, `data-uid` and `data-trigger-proxy-id`. (zag: packages/machines/navigation-menu/src/navigation-menu.connect.ts)
- The content is `hidden` unless selected, with `aria-labelledby` on its trigger id, `data-state`, `data-orientation`, `data-value` and `data-uid`, and it keeps itself open through pointerenter and pointerleave handlers. (zag: packages/machines/navigation-menu/src/navigation-menu.connect.ts)
- A hidden trigger-proxy element with `aria-hidden`, `tabIndex={0}` and `data-trigger-proxy` exists while an item is selected, so Tab can move between the trigger and the content in either direction; it sends a content-focus event whose side depends on whether the trigger was focused. (zag: packages/machines/navigation-menu/src/navigation-menu.connect.ts)
- A viewport-proxy element uses `aria-owns` to associate the content with the viewport for assistive tech when the content is rendered inside a shared viewport. (zag: packages/machines/navigation-menu/src/navigation-menu.connect.ts)
- Links carry `data-value`, `data-ownedby` on the content id, `data-current` and `aria-current="page"` when marked current. (zag: packages/machines/navigation-menu/src/navigation-menu.connect.ts)
- The indicator, item indicator and arrow are `aria-hidden`, hidden while closed, and carry `data-state` and `data-orientation`; the viewport and its positioner carry `data-state`, `data-orientation` and `data-align`, and the viewport re-declares `--viewport-width`, `--viewport-height`, `--viewport-x` and `--viewport-y`. (zag: packages/machines/navigation-menu/src/navigation-menu.connect.ts)

### Keyboard

- Given a focused trigger, when Enter is pressed, then the content opens, and pressing Enter again closes it; Tab then Enter opens the next trigger's content and closes the previous one. (zag: e2e/navigation-menu.e2e.ts: "trigger switch, using the keyboard")
- Given a focused trigger, when Enter or Space is pressed, then the content opens either way. (zag: e2e/navigation-menu.e2e.ts: "opening with enter vs space key")
- Given a focused trigger, when ArrowRight is pressed, then focus moves to the next trigger, and further presses reach a plain link; ArrowLeft walks back through them. (zag: e2e/navigation-menu.e2e.ts: "arrow key navigation between triggers")
- Given focus on a middle trigger, when Home is pressed, then focus jumps to the first trigger, and End jumps to the last focusable element in the list. (zag: e2e/navigation-menu.e2e.ts: "Home and End key navigation on triggers")
- Given open content with the first link focused, when ArrowDown is pressed, then focus walks down the content links one at a time. (zag: e2e/navigation-menu.e2e.ts: "arrow down navigation within content")
- Given open content with a later link focused, when ArrowUp is pressed, then focus walks back up the content links. (zag: e2e/navigation-menu.e2e.ts: "arrow up navigation within content")
- Given open content, when Home and End are pressed, then focus jumps to the first and last link inside the content. (zag: e2e/navigation-menu.e2e.ts: "Home and End key navigation in content")
- Given the first link is focused, when ArrowUp is pressed, then focus stays put, and from the last link ArrowDown also stays put, so arrow navigation inside content does not loop. (zag: e2e/navigation-menu.e2e.ts: "arrow navigation does not loop in content")

### Pointer

- Given the basic navigation menu, when a trigger is hovered, then its content opens. (zag: e2e/navigation-menu.e2e.ts: "should open on hover")
- Given the basic navigation menu, when a trigger is clicked, then its content opens. (zag: e2e/navigation-menu.e2e.ts: "should open on click")
- Given content open from hover, when another trigger is hovered, then the new content opens and the previous one closes. (zag: e2e/navigation-menu.e2e.ts: "trigger switch, using hover")
- Given content opened by hover, when the same trigger is clicked, then the content closes, and continuing to hover it does not reopen it. (zag: e2e/navigation-menu.e2e.ts: "hover + focus should toggle content")
- Given content opened by hover then closed by click, when the pointer stays on the trigger, then it stays closed; moving to another trigger and back reopens it. (zag: e2e/navigation-menu.e2e.ts: "hover, click to close, hover out and back in")
- Given one menu already open, when a different trigger is hovered, then the switch is instant with no open delay. (zag: e2e/navigation-menu.e2e.ts: "switching menus is instant when one is open")
- Given content opened by hover, when the trigger is clicked once to close and clicked again immediately, then the second click reopens it rather than being swallowed. (zag: e2e/navigation-menu.e2e.ts: "hover to open, click same trigger twice rapidly")
- Given rapid hovering across three triggers, then the final hovered content is the only one open. (zag: e2e/navigation-menu.e2e.ts: "multiple menus rapid switching")

### Focus management

- Given content opened with Enter, when Tab is pressed, then focus moves into the content's first link. (zag: e2e/navigation-menu.e2e.ts: "focus link on tab"; zag: e2e/navigation-menu.e2e.ts: "focus moves from trigger to content does not close")
- Given focus inside content, when Tab is pressed enough times to leave it, then focus lands on the next trigger, opening that content with Enter closes the previous one, and tabbing past the list closes everything. (zag: e2e/navigation-menu.e2e.ts: "tab navigation")
- Given focus on a content link, when Shift+Tab is pressed, then focus returns to the trigger and the content stays open. (zag: e2e/navigation-menu.e2e.ts: "focus moves from content to trigger does not close")
- Given focus has walked forward to a later trigger, when Shift+Tab is pressed repeatedly, then focus walks back through the content links and finally to the original trigger. (zag: e2e/navigation-menu.e2e.ts: "shift+tab navigation (backwards)")
- Given focus inside the content, when Escape is pressed, then the content closes and focus returns to its trigger. (zag: e2e/navigation-menu.e2e.ts: "focus restoration after escape"; zag: e2e/navigation-menu.e2e.ts: "escape from different positions in content restores focus")
- Given content opened by hover and then tabbed into, when Escape closes it, then focus returns to the trigger and Enter can open it again. (zag: e2e/navigation-menu.e2e.ts: "hover open and keyboard close restores proper state")
- Given one menu was opened and closed with the keyboard, when a second menu is opened, then tabbing walks its own content links in order. (zag: e2e/navigation-menu.e2e.ts: "opening multiple menus maintains proper tab order")

### Dismissal and layering

- Given open content, when a click lands outside, then it closes. (zag: e2e/navigation-menu.e2e.ts: "should close when clicking outside")
- Given open content, when Escape is pressed, then it closes. (zag: e2e/navigation-menu.e2e.ts: "should close when pressing escape")
- Given content opened by keyboard, when the pointer hovers a different trigger, then that content opens, Escape closes it, hovering reopens the first, Escape closes again and keyboard opening still works, so modality can be swapped repeatedly. (zag: e2e/navigation-menu.e2e.ts: "keyboard open, mouse hover, escape close, then continue")
- Given a close delay started by clicking outside, when Escape is pressed before the delay elapses, then the content closes immediately rather than waiting. (zag: e2e/navigation-menu.e2e.ts: "escape during close delay cancels the close")

### Accessibility tooling

- Given the basic navigation menu, when axe runs over the root, then there are no violations. (zag: e2e/navigation-menu.e2e.ts: "should have no accessibility violation")

### Notes and edge cases

- No Ark framework package ships navigation-menu tests, so its contract is pinned only by the Zag e2e spec and the connect source. (zag: e2e/navigation-menu.e2e.ts)

## select

### Roles and attributes

- Anatomy parts are label, positioner, trigger, indicator, clearTrigger, item, itemText, itemIndicator, itemGroup, itemGroupLabel, list, content, root, control, valueText; every part element carries `data-scope="select"` and `data-part="<part>"` with camelCase parts kebab-cased (`clear-trigger`, `item-text`, `item-indicator`, `item-group`, `item-group-label`, `value-text`). (zag: packages/machines/select/src/select.anatomy.ts)
- The root part has `id="select:<id>"`, `dir`, `data-invalid` and `data-readonly`. (zag: packages/machines/select/src/select.connect.ts)
- The label part renders as a native `label` with `id="select:<id>:label"`, `htmlFor` pointing at the hidden select id `select:<id>:select`, plus `data-disabled`, `data-invalid`, `data-readonly` and `data-required`. (zag: packages/machines/select/src/select.connect.ts)
- The control part has `id="select:<id>:control"`, `data-state` of `open` or `closed`, `data-focus`, `data-disabled` and `data-invalid`. (zag: packages/machines/select/src/select.connect.ts)
- The value-text part has `data-disabled`, `data-invalid` and `data-focus` only, no role of its own. (zag: packages/machines/select/src/select.connect.ts)
- The trigger part is a `button` with `type="button"`, `role="combobox"`, `aria-controls` set to the content id, `aria-expanded` reflecting open, `aria-haspopup="listbox"`, `aria-invalid`, `aria-required`, `aria-labelledby` pointing at the label id, and the native `disabled` attribute. (zag: packages/machines/select/src/select.connect.ts)
- The trigger also carries `data-state` open/closed, `data-disabled`, `data-invalid`, `data-readonly`, `data-placement` (full popper placement), `data-side` (placement side) and `data-placeholder-shown` when nothing is selected. (zag: packages/machines/select/src/select.connect.ts)
- The indicator part is `aria-hidden="true"` with `data-state` open/closed, `data-disabled`, `data-invalid` and `data-readonly`. (zag: packages/machines/select/src/select.connect.ts)
- Each item has `id="select:<id>:option:<value>"`, `role="option"`, `data-value`, `aria-selected`, `data-state` of `checked` or `unchecked`, `data-highlighted` when it is the highlighted value, `data-disabled` and `aria-disabled` when the item or the whole select is disabled. (zag: packages/machines/select/src/select.connect.ts)
- The item-text part mirrors the item with `data-state` checked/unchecked, `data-disabled` and `data-highlighted`. (zag: packages/machines/select/src/select.connect.ts)
- The item-indicator part is `aria-hidden="true"`, has `data-state` checked/unchecked, and is `hidden` whenever the item is not selected. (zag: packages/machines/select/src/select.connect.ts)
- The item-group part has `role="group"`, `id="select:<id>:optgroup:<groupId>"`, `aria-labelledby` pointing at the group label id, and `data-disabled` from the root disabled state. (zag: packages/machines/select/src/select.connect.ts)
- The item-group-label part has `role="presentation"` and `id="select:<id>:optgroup-label:<htmlFor>"`. (zag: packages/machines/select/src/select.connect.ts)
- The clear-trigger part is a `button` with `type="button"`, `aria-label` from `translations.clearTriggerLabel` (default `"Clear value"`), `data-invalid`, the native `disabled` attribute, and `hidden` whenever there are no selected items. (zag: packages/machines/select/src/select.connect.ts)
- The content part is `hidden` while closed, has `id="select:<id>:content"`, `data-state` open/closed, `data-placement`, `data-side`, `aria-labelledby` the label id and `tabIndex={0}`. (zag: packages/machines/select/src/select.connect.ts)
- The content part's role is `"listbox"` when the `composite` prop is on and `"dialog"` when composition is off, so the listbox semantics move to the list part for non-composite usage. (zag: packages/machines/select/src/select.connect.ts)
- The content part always exposes `data-activedescendant` with the highlighted item id, but `aria-activedescendant` only when `composite`; `aria-multiselectable="true"` appears on content only when both `multiple` and `composite` hold. (zag: packages/machines/select/src/select.connect.ts)
- The list part has `tabIndex={0}`, `aria-labelledby` the trigger id, and takes over `role="listbox"`, `aria-activedescendant` and `aria-multiselectable="true"` exactly when `composite` is false. (zag: packages/machines/select/src/select.connect.ts)
- The positioner part has `id="select:<id>:positioner"` and the popper floating inline styles: `position` from `strategy`, `isolation: isolate`, `min-width: max-content` (replaced by `width: var(--reference-width)` under `sameWidth`), `max-width: var(--available-width)` and `max-height: var(--available-height)` under `fitViewport`, `top: 0px`, `left: 0px`, `transform: translate3d(var(--x), var(--y), 0)` and `z-index: var(--z-index)`. (zag: packages/machines/select/src/select.connect.ts; zag: packages/utilities/popper/src/get-styles.ts)
- Before a placement is computed the positioner gets `pointer-events: none` and `transform: translate3d(0, -100vh, 0)` so the unmeasured popup sits off screen. (zag: packages/utilities/popper/src/get-styles.ts)
- Given a rendered Ark Select with a disabled prop, then the `combobox` trigger has the native `disabled` attribute. (ark: packages/react/src/components/select/tests/select.test.tsx: "should be disabled when disabled is true"; ark: packages/solid/src/components/select/tests/select.test.tsx: "should be disabled when disabled is true"; ark: packages/vue/src/components/select/tests/select.test.ts: "should be disabled when disabled is true")
- Given the Svelte Select basic example with `Select.ValueText placeholder="Select"`, when rendered, then both the placeholder text `Select` and the label text `Framework` are in the document. (ark: packages/svelte/src/lib/components/select/select.test.ts: "should render select with placeholder")

### Keyboard

- Given the dropdown opened by trigger click, when ArrowDown is pressed three times, then the third item down (`Afghanistan`) is `data-highlighted` and scrolled inside the content viewport. (zag: e2e/select.e2e.ts: "open with keyboard > should navigate on arrow down")
- Given the dropdown opened by trigger click, when ArrowUp is pressed three times, then `South Africa` is highlighted and in the content viewport, so ArrowUp from no highlight starts at the last item and walks up. (zag: e2e/select.e2e.ts: "open with keyboard > should navigate on arrow up")
- Given the open dropdown, when End then Home are pressed, then `Zimbabwe` is highlighted and in view, then `Andorra` is highlighted and in view. (zag: e2e/select.e2e.ts: "open with keyboard > should navigate on home/end")
- Given the open dropdown, when `Cy` is typed into the content, then `Cyprus` is highlighted and scrolled into the content viewport. (zag: e2e/select.e2e.ts: "open with keyboard > should navigate on typeahead")
- Given `loopFocus` enabled and the dropdown opened with Enter from the focused trigger, when ArrowUp then ArrowDown are pressed, then the highlight wraps to `Zimbabwe` and then back round to `Andorra`; the content element itself is focused after opening. (zag: e2e/select.e2e.ts: "open with keyboard > should loop through the options when loop is enabled")
- Given the open dropdown with the first item highlighted by ArrowDown, when Enter is pressed, then `Andorra` gets `data-state="checked"`, the trigger shows `Andorra` and focus returns to the trigger. (zag: e2e/select.e2e.ts: "keyboard / select > should select on enter")
- Given the open dropdown with the first item highlighted by ArrowDown, when Space is pressed, then `Andorra` is checked, the trigger shows `Andorra` and focus returns to the trigger. (zag: e2e/select.e2e.ts: "keyboard / select > should select on space")
- Given the focused but closed trigger, when Enter is pressed, then the content becomes visible. (zag: e2e/select.e2e.ts: "focused / open > should open the select with enter key")
- Given the focused but closed trigger, when Space is pressed, then the content becomes visible. (zag: e2e/select.e2e.ts: "focused / open > should open the select with space key")
- Given the focused but closed trigger, when ArrowDown is pressed, then the content opens with the first item `Andorra` highlighted. (zag: e2e/select.e2e.ts: "focused / open > should open with down arrow keys + highlight first option")
- Given the focused but closed trigger, when ArrowUp is pressed, then the content opens with the last item `Zimbabwe` highlighted. (zag: e2e/select.e2e.ts: "focused / open > should open with up arrow keys  + highlight last option")
- Given the focused closed trigger with no value, when ArrowLeft is pressed, then the last option `Zimbabwe` is selected without opening the dropdown. (zag: e2e/select.e2e.ts: "closed state + keyboard selection > should select last option on arrow left")
- Given the focused closed trigger with no value, when ArrowRight is pressed, then the first option `Andorra` is selected without opening. (zag: e2e/select.e2e.ts: "closed state + keyboard selection > should select first option on arrow right")
- Given the focused closed trigger, when ArrowRight is pressed three times, then the selection steps `Andorra`, `United Arab Emirates`, `Afghanistan` in collection order. (zag: e2e/select.e2e.ts: "closed state + keyboard selection > should select next options on arrow right")
- Given the focused closed trigger, when `Nigeri` is typed, then `Nigeria` becomes the checked item while the dropdown stays closed. (zag: e2e/select.e2e.ts: "closed state + keyboard selection > should select with typeahead")
- Given the focused closed trigger, when `P` is typed three times in a row, then selection cycles `Panama`, `Peru`, `Papua New Guinea`; after a 350ms wait typing `K` starts a fresh search and selects `Kenya`. (zag: e2e/select.e2e.ts: "closed state + keyboard selection > should cycle selected value with typeahead")
- The trigger keydown map handles ArrowUp, ArrowDown (with `altKey` opening instead of stepping the value), ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, Home, End, Enter and Space, calls `preventDefault` on each, and otherwise forwards printable keys to typeahead; Space forwards to typeahead instead of Enter while a typeahead search is in flight. (zag: packages/machines/select/src/select.connect.ts)
- The content keydown map handles ArrowUp, ArrowDown, Home, End, Enter and Space, calls `preventDefault`, treats Space as typeahead while typing ahead, ignores keys originating from editable elements, and blocks Tab unless `isValidTabEvent` says the focus target is legitimately inside a composed widget. (zag: packages/machines/select/src/select.connect.ts)

### Pointer

- Given the closed select, when the trigger is clicked twice, then the content becomes visible and then hidden again. (zag: e2e/select.e2e.ts: "pointer > should toggle select")
- Given `deselectable` enabled, when `Albania` is clicked, the dropdown is reopened and `Albania` is clicked a second time, then the trigger falls back to the `Select option` placeholder. (zag: e2e/select.e2e.ts: "pointer > should deselect")
- Given the open dropdown, when `Albania` is hovered and then `Algeria` is hovered, then the highlight (`data-highlighted=""`) follows the pointer to each item. (zag: e2e/select.e2e.ts: "pointer > should highlight on hover")
- Given the open dropdown with `Afghanistan (AF)` hovered and highlighted, when End is pressed, then the highlight moves to `Zimbabwe (ZW)` and stays there even though the keyboard scroll slides new content under the resting cursor, and `Zimbabwe (ZW)` is scrolled into view. (zag: e2e/select.e2e.ts: "select / scroll under resting cursor > on end key, keep highlight when scroll moves content under the cursor")
- Given the open dropdown after a keyboard scroll to `Zimbabwe (ZW)` via End, when `Zambia (ZM)` is hovered, then the highlight moves to `Zambia (ZM)`, so real pointer input still wins after keyboard scrolling. (zag: e2e/select.e2e.ts: "select / scroll under resting cursor > after keyboard scroll, hover still moves the highlight")
- Item `onPointerMove` only highlights when `event.pointerType === "mouse"`, when `getInteractionModality()` is `pointer`, and when the item is not already highlighted, which is how keyboard-driven scroll events that fire pointermove under a resting cursor are ignored. (zag: packages/machines/select/src/select.connect.ts)
- Item `onPointerLeave` clears the highlight only for mouse pointers under pointer modality and is skipped entirely when the item sets `persistFocus`. (zag: packages/machines/select/src/select.connect.ts)
- Item selection is sent as `ITEM.CLICK` with `src: "pointerup"` from `onClick`, and disabled items short-circuit before dispatch. (zag: packages/machines/select/src/select.connect.ts)
- Given the Ark Select basic example, when the `combobox` trigger is clicked and the `React` item text is clicked, then the trigger's text content becomes `React`. (ark: packages/react/src/components/select/tests/select.test.tsx: "should handle item selection"; ark: packages/solid/src/components/select/tests/select.test.tsx: "should handle item selection"; ark: packages/vue/src/components/select/tests/select.test.ts: "should handle item selection")
- Given the Svelte Select basic example, when the `combobox` trigger is clicked, then options named `React` and `Svelte` are in the document. (ark: packages/svelte/src/lib/components/select/select.test.ts: "should open dropdown when clicked")

### Focus management

- Given the select, when the label is clicked, then focus lands on the trigger, because the label's `onClick` calls `trigger.focus({ preventScroll: true })` unless the select is disabled. (zag: e2e/select.e2e.ts: "accessibility > clicking the label should focus control"; zag: packages/machines/select/src/select.connect.ts)
- Given `Albania` selected via the dropdown, when the clear trigger is clicked, then focus returns to the trigger and the trigger text resets to `Select option`. (zag: e2e/select.e2e.ts: "pointer > clicking clear trigger should return focus")
- The hidden native select forwards focus to the trigger in its `onFocus` handler, so browser extensions that focus it cannot strand focus on an `aria-hidden` element. (zag: packages/machines/select/src/select.connect.ts)
- Given a Select inside `Field.Root`, when the field label is clicked, then the `combobox` named by that label has focus. (ark: packages/react/src/components/select/tests/select.test.tsx: "Select / Field > should focus on input when label is clicked"; ark: packages/solid/src/components/select/tests/select.test.tsx: "Select / Field > should focus on input when label is clicked"; ark: packages/vue/src/components/select/tests/select.test.ts: "Select / Field > should focus on input when label is clicked")

- Given the `/select/controlled-ignore` example whose `value` prop is pinned to React, when `Vue` is clicked, then the rendered `selected-items` node still contains `React` and never contains `Vue`, so `selectedItems` follows the controlled value rather than the click. ### Notes and edge cases

- `getItemState` throws `[zag-js] No value found for item <json>` via `ensure` when the collection yields no value for an item, and treats an item as disabled if either the item or the whole select is disabled. (zag: packages/machines/select/src/select.connect.ts)
- The connect API exposes `open`, `focused`, `empty`, `highlightedItem`, `highlightedValue`, `selectedItems`, `hasSelectedItems`, `value`, `valueAsString`, `collection`, `multiple`, `disabled` plus the imperative `reposition`, `focus`, `setOpen`, `selectValue`, `setValue`, `selectAll`, `setHighlightValue`, `clearHighlightValue` and `clearValue(value?)`. (zag: packages/machines/select/src/select.connect.ts)
- The machine prop surface includes `autoComplete`, `closeOnSelect`, `composite`, `defaultHighlightedValue`, `deselectable`, `loopFocus`, `multiple`, `scrollToIndexFn`, `translations`, and the `onHighlightChange`/`onSelect`/`onValueChange`/`onOpenChange`/`onFocusOutside`/`onInteractOutside`/`onPointerDownOutside` callbacks; item props are `item` and `persistFocus`. (zag: packages/machines/select/src/select.props.ts)
- The Ark Solid `close on select` test drives the interaction with `fireEvent.click` rather than `user-event`, where React and Vue both use `user.click`. (ark: packages/solid/src/components/select/tests/select.test.tsx: "should close on select")
- The Ark Solid lazy-mount-and-unmount test asserts the positioner removal synchronously, where React and Vue wrap the same assertion in `waitFor`. (ark: packages/solid/src/components/select/tests/select.test.tsx: "should be able to lazy mount and unmount its items")
- The Ark test fixtures build the collection per framework: React with `createListCollection` in render, Solid with `createListCollection` plus `<For>`, Vue with a module-scope `createListCollection<Item>` plus `useForwardPropsEmits(props, emits)` and `:openDelay="0" :closeDelay="0"`, Svelte with a module-scope collection and `{#each}`; only React and Solid portal the positioner via `Portal`, Vue uses `<Teleport to="body">`. (ark: packages/react/src/components/select/tests/basic.tsx; ark: packages/solid/src/components/select/tests/basic.tsx; ark: packages/vue/src/components/select/tests/select.test.vue; ark: packages/svelte/src/lib/components/select/examples/basic.svelte)
- No Ark select test exercises `RootProvider`, `asChild`/`render` props, or `Select.Context`; the React and Solid fixtures place `Select.List` inside the positioner (React as a sibling of Content, Solid inside Content), so list placement is not pinned by a test. (ark: packages/react/src/components/select/tests/basic.tsx; ark: packages/solid/src/components/select/tests/basic.tsx)
- The Ark Field fixtures build the collection from bare strings (`createListCollection({ items: ['React', 'Solid', 'Vue', 'Svelte'] })`), so string items are supported as collection entries. (ark: packages/react/src/components/select/tests/field.tsx; ark: packages/vue/src/components/select/tests/field.test.vue)

## listbox

### Roles and attributes

- Anatomy parts are label, input, item, itemText, itemIndicator, itemGroup, itemGroupLabel, content, root, valueText; every part element carries `data-scope="listbox"` and `data-part="<part>"` (`item-text`, `item-indicator`, `item-group`, `item-group-label`, `value-text`). (zag: packages/machines/listbox/src/listbox.anatomy.ts)
- The root part has `id`, `dir`, `data-orientation` from the `orientation` prop and `data-disabled`. (zag: packages/machines/listbox/src/listbox.connect.ts)
- The content part has `role="listbox"`, `tabIndex={0}`, `aria-labelledby` the label id, `aria-activedescendant` and a mirrored `data-activedescendant` holding the highlighted item id, `aria-multiselectable="true"` when the computed selection mode is multiple, `data-orientation`, `data-layout` of `grid` or `list`, and `data-empty` when the collection size is zero. (zag: packages/machines/listbox/src/listbox.connect.ts)
- The content part sets the CSS custom property `--column-count` to the grid collection's `columnCount`, or `1` for a plain list collection. (zag: packages/machines/listbox/src/listbox.connect.ts)
- Unlike select, listbox keeps the listbox role and `aria-activedescendant` on the content part itself and drives selection through roving `aria-activedescendant` while the content element holds real DOM focus. (zag: packages/machines/listbox/src/listbox.connect.ts)
- The optional input part is an `input` with `autoComplete="off"`, `autoCorrect="off"`, `spellCheck={false}`, `enterKeyHint="go"`, `aria-haspopup="listbox"`, `aria-controls` the content id, `aria-autocomplete="list"`, `aria-activedescendant` for the highlighted item, plus `disabled` and `data-disabled`. (zag: packages/machines/listbox/src/listbox.connect.ts)
- The label part has an `id`, `dir` and `data-disabled`; the value-text part has only `dir` and `data-disabled`. (zag: packages/machines/listbox/src/listbox.connect.ts)
- Each item has an `id`, `role="option"`, `data-value`, `aria-selected`, `data-selected`, `data-layout` (`grid` or `list`), `data-state` of `checked` or `unchecked`, `data-orientation`, `data-highlighted`, `data-disabled` and `aria-disabled`. (zag: packages/machines/listbox/src/listbox.connect.ts)
- Item state distinguishes `focused` (highlighted and the listbox focused), `focusVisible` (highlighted and focus-visible) and the deprecated `highlighted` flag, which resolves to focused when an input is focused and to focus-visible otherwise. (zag: packages/machines/listbox/src/listbox.connect.ts)
- The item-text part has `data-state` checked/unchecked, `data-disabled` and `data-highlighted`. (zag: packages/machines/listbox/src/listbox.connect.ts)
- The item-indicator part is `aria-hidden="true"`, has `data-state` checked/unchecked, and is `hidden` unless the item is selected. (zag: packages/machines/listbox/src/listbox.connect.ts)
- The item-group part has `role="group"`, an `id`, `aria-labelledby` its group label id, `data-disabled`, `data-orientation` and `data-empty` when the collection is empty. (zag: packages/machines/listbox/src/listbox.connect.ts)
- The item-group-label part has `role="presentation"` and an `id` derived from its `htmlFor`. (zag: packages/machines/listbox/src/listbox.connect.ts)
- Given the Ark Listbox with four items, when rendered, then options named `React`, `Solid` and `Vue` are all findable by role. (ark: packages/react/src/components/listbox/listbox.test.tsx: "should render all available options"; ark: packages/solid/src/components/listbox/listbox.test.tsx: "should render all available options"; ark: packages/vue/src/components/listbox/tests/listbox.test.ts: "should render all available options")
- Given a collection whose `Svelte` item has `disabled: true`, when rendered, then that option has `aria-disabled="true"`. (ark: packages/react/src/components/listbox/listbox.test.tsx: "should render disabled items with appropriate attributes"; ark: packages/solid/src/components/listbox/listbox.test.tsx: "should render disabled items with appropriate attributes"; ark: packages/vue/src/components/listbox/tests/listbox.test.ts: "should render disabled items with appropriate attributes")
- Given `defaultValue={['react']}`, when rendered, then the `React` option has `aria-selected="true"`. (ark: packages/react/src/components/listbox/listbox.test.tsx: "should mark the default selected option with aria-selected attribute"; ark: packages/solid/src/components/listbox/listbox.test.tsx: "should mark the default selected option with aria-selected attribute"; ark: packages/vue/src/components/listbox/tests/listbox.test.ts: "should mark the default selected option with aria-selected attribute")

### Keyboard

- Given the basic listbox tabbed into so the content has focus and `Andorra` is highlighted, when ArrowDown is pressed, then `United Arab Emirates` becomes `data-highlighted=""`. (zag: e2e/listbox.e2e.ts: "listbox > no highlighted item, arrow down")
- Given `loopFocus` enabled and the content tabbed into with `Andorra` highlighted, when ArrowUp is pressed, then the highlight wraps to the last item `Zimbabwe`. (zag: e2e/listbox.e2e.ts: "listbox > no highlighted item, arrow up")
- Given the content focused by tabbing, when End is pressed, then `Zimbabwe` is highlighted and scrolled inside the content viewport. (zag: e2e/listbox.e2e.ts: "listbox > should scroll selected option into view")
- The content ArrowUp/ArrowDown handlers step through the collection, use `getPreviousRowValue`/`getNextRowValue` for grid collections, and fall back to the last/first value when there is no next value and either `loopFocus` is set or nothing is highlighted yet. (zag: packages/machines/listbox/src/listbox.connect.ts)
- The content ArrowLeft/ArrowRight handlers are no-ops for a non-grid collection with `orientation="vertical"`, and otherwise step previous/next with `loopFocus` wraparound. (zag: packages/machines/listbox/src/listbox.connect.ts)
- Home and End navigate to the collection's first and last value, call `preventDefault`, and bail out when the event target is an editable element. (zag: packages/machines/listbox/src/listbox.connect.ts)
- Every navigation key sends `NAVIGATE` with `shiftKey` and the previous highlighted value as `anchorValue`, which is how shift-range selection is anchored. (zag: packages/machines/listbox/src/listbox.connect.ts)
- Enter sends `ITEM.CLICK` for the highlighted value; Space forwards to typeahead while a typeahead search is in flight and the `typeahead` prop is on, otherwise it behaves like Enter. (zag: packages/machines/listbox/src/listbox.connect.ts)
- Ctrl/Cmd plus `a` selects every value in the collection, but only in multiple selection mode and only when `disallowSelectAll` is not set. (zag: packages/machines/listbox/src/listbox.connect.ts)
- Escape clears the value (with `preventDefault` and `stopPropagation`) only when the `deselectable` prop is set and at least one value is selected. (zag: packages/machines/listbox/src/listbox.connect.ts)
- Printable keys run typeahead only when the `typeahead` prop is on and the target is not an editable element. (zag: packages/machines/listbox/src/listbox.connect.ts)
- The input part forwards ArrowDown and ArrowUp to the content element by re-dispatching a cloned `KeyboardEvent`, forwards ArrowLeft/ArrowRight only for grid collections without Ctrl when `keyboardPriority` is `"navigate"`, forwards Home/End only under `keyboardPriority === "navigate"` (and not for a shift press with nothing highlighted), handles Enter locally by selecting the highlighted value, and ignores keys during IME composition. (zag: packages/machines/listbox/src/listbox.connect.ts)

### Pointer

- Given the basic listbox with the content focused and the pointer resting over `Afghanistan` (which highlights it), when End moves the highlight to `Zimbabwe` and the mouse is then moved to the same unchanged coordinates, then the highlight stays on `Zimbabwe`, and a real hover on `Zambia` afterwards moves it; the test comment pins the WebKit behaviour of emitting a pointermove at an unchanged position when content scrolls under a resting cursor. (zag: e2e/listbox.e2e.ts: "listbox > should keep keyboard highlight when content scrolls under a resting pointer")
- Item `onPointerMove` highlights only when the item opts in via `highlightOnHover`, the pointer type is `mouse`, `getInteractionModality()` is `pointer`, and the item is not already highlighted. (zag: packages/machines/listbox/src/listbox.connect.ts)
- Item `onMouseDown` calls `preventDefault` and focuses the content element, so clicking an option keeps DOM focus on the listbox container rather than the option. (zag: packages/machines/listbox/src/listbox.connect.ts)
- Item `onClick` ignores download-modifier clicks, new-tab clicks and contextmenu events, skips disabled items, and sends `ITEM.CLICK` with `shiftKey`, `metaKey` (Ctrl or Meta) and the current highlighted value as `anchorValue`. (zag: packages/machines/listbox/src/listbox.connect.ts)
- Given the Ark Listbox, when the `React` option is clicked, then `onValueChange` is called first with `{ items: [{ label: 'React', value: 'react' }], value: ['react'] }`. (ark: packages/react/src/components/listbox/listbox.test.tsx: "should invoke onValueChange callback when an option is selected"; ark: packages/solid/src/components/listbox/listbox.test.tsx: "should invoke onValueChange callback when an option is selected"; ark: packages/vue/src/components/listbox/tests/listbox.test.ts: "should invoke valueChange event when an option is selected")
- Given the Ark Listbox, when the `React` option is clicked, then `onSelect` is called with `{ value: 'react' }`. (ark: packages/react/src/components/listbox/listbox.test.tsx: "should invoke onSelect callback when an option is selected"; ark: packages/solid/src/components/listbox/listbox.test.tsx: "should invoke onSelect callback when an option is selected"; ark: packages/vue/src/components/listbox/tests/listbox.test.ts: "should invoke select event when an option is selected")

### Focus management

- Given the basic listbox page, when `main.listbox` is clicked at (300, 30) and Tab is pressed, then the content part itself receives DOM focus and `Andorra` is highlighted, so entry into the widget is a single tab stop with `aria-activedescendant` tracking the highlight. (zag: e2e/listbox.e2e.ts: "listbox > no highlighted item, arrow down")
- The content part sends `CONTENT.FOCUS` on focus and `CONTENT.BLUR` on blur, and the input part sends `INPUT.FOCUS` in a microtask (with `autoHighlight`) and `CONTENT.BLUR` with `src: "input"` on blur. (zag: packages/machines/listbox/src/listbox.connect.ts)

### State and controlled/uncontrolled

- Given the `/listbox/controlled-ignore` example whose value is pinned to React, when `Vue` is clicked, then the rendered `selected-items` node still contains `React` and never `Vue`. (zag: e2e/listbox.e2e.ts: "listbox > [composition] controlled-ignore should keep selectedItems aligned with controlled value")
- Given the `/listbox/external-value-change` example, when the collection is filtered to Vue and the value is then set to Solid externally, then `selected-items` contains `Solid` and the `Solid` item has `data-state="checked"`. (zag: e2e/listbox.e2e.ts: "listbox > [composition] external value change should keep item selection in sync")
- Given `selectionMode="multiple"` with `defaultValue={['react']}`, when the `Solid` option is clicked, then `onValueChange` is called first with `{ items: [React, Solid], value: ['react', 'solid'] }`, so the existing selection is preserved and appended to. (ark: packages/react/src/components/listbox/listbox.test.tsx: "should allow multiple selections when selectionMode is multiple"; ark: packages/solid/src/components/listbox/listbox.test.tsx: "should allow multiple selections when selectionMode is multiple"; ark: packages/vue/src/components/listbox/tests/listbox.test.ts: "should allow multiple selections when selectionMode is multiple")
- Given the Vue Listbox bound with `modelValue: []` and an `onUpdate:modelValue` handler, when the `React` option is clicked, then the handler is called with `['react']`, so `v-model` is the Vue controlled channel. (ark: packages/vue/src/components/listbox/tests/listbox.test.ts: "should update v-model when an option is selected")
- Given a Solid Listbox rendering `Listbox.ItemContext` per item, when the `React` option is clicked, then the `react-selected` node's text flips from `false` to `true` while `solid-selected` stays `false`, so the item context signal is reactive. (ark: packages/solid/src/components/listbox/listbox.test.tsx: "should update ItemContext.selected after an option is selected")
- `selectAll()` throws `[zag-js] Cannot select all items in a single-select listbox` when the computed selection mode is not multiple. (zag: packages/machines/listbox/src/listbox.connect.ts)
- The input part's `onInput` clears the highlighted value in a microtask when `autoHighlight` is on and the typed value is only whitespace. (zag: packages/machines/listbox/src/listbox.connect.ts)

### Accessibility tooling

- Given the basic listbox example, when axe runs over the default `[data-part=root]` selector with `color-contrast` disabled, then there are no violations. (zag: e2e/listbox.e2e.ts: "listbox > should have no accessibility violation")
- Given the Ark Listbox with label, value text, content, item group, group label, items, item text and item indicator, when axe runs over the container, then there are no violations. (ark: packages/react/src/components/listbox/listbox.test.tsx: "should have no accessibility violations"; ark: packages/solid/src/components/listbox/listbox.test.tsx: "should have no accessibility violations"; ark: packages/vue/src/components/listbox/tests/listbox.test.ts: "should have no a11y violations")

### Notes and edge cases

- `getItemState` throws `[zag-js] No value found for item <json>` via `ensure` when the collection yields no value for an item. (zag: packages/machines/listbox/src/listbox.connect.ts)
- The layout flag is derived once from `isGridCollection(collection)` and stamped as `data-layout` on both content and items, so grid listboxes are distinguishable from CSS. (zag: packages/machines/listbox/src/listbox.connect.ts)
- The connect API exposes `empty`, `highlightedItem`, `highlightedValue`, `selectedItems`, `hasSelectedItems`, `value`, `valueAsString`, `collection`, `disabled` plus `clearHighlightedValue`, `selectValue`, `setValue`, `selectAll`, `highlightValue`, `highlightFirst`, `highlightLast`, `highlightNext`, `highlightPrevious` and `clearValue(value?)`. (zag: packages/machines/listbox/src/listbox.connect.ts)
- The machine prop surface includes `deselectable`, `disallowSelectAll`, `loopFocus`, `orientation`, `selectionMode`, `selectOnHighlight`, `typeahead`, `scrollToIndexFn`, `defaultHighlightedValue` and the `onHighlightChange`/`onSelect`/`onValueChange` callbacks; item props are `item` and `highlightOnHover`, so highlight-on-hover is opt-in per item rather than global. (zag: packages/machines/listbox/src/listbox.props.ts)
- The Solid Listbox fixture gives both `Solid` and `Svelte` the value `'solid'`, a duplicate-value collection that the React and Vue fixtures do not have. (ark: packages/solid/src/components/listbox/listbox.test.tsx)
- The Ark Listbox fixtures create the collection per framework: React with `createListCollection` inside the component and `collection.items.map`, Solid with `<Index each={collection.items}>` and `item()` accessors, Vue with a module-scope collection, `v-for`, and `useForwardPropsEmits(props, emits)` to relay `onValueChange`/`onSelect`/`onUpdate:modelValue`. (ark: packages/react/src/components/listbox/listbox.test.tsx; ark: packages/solid/src/components/listbox/listbox.test.tsx; ark: packages/vue/src/components/listbox/tests/listbox.test.vue)
- No Ark Listbox test covers `RootProvider`, `asChild`/`render` props, keyboard navigation, typeahead or `Field` integration; there is no Svelte Listbox test file at all. (ark: packages/react/src/components/listbox/listbox.test.tsx)

## cascade-select

### Roles and attributes

- Anatomy parts are root, label, control, trigger, indicator, valueText, clearTrigger, positioner, content, list, item, itemText, itemIndicator; every part element carries `data-scope="cascade-select"` and `data-part="<part>"` (`value-text`, `clear-trigger`, `item-text`, `item-indicator`). (zag: packages/machines/cascade-select/src/cascade-select.anatomy.ts)
- The root part has an `id`, `dir`, `data-disabled`, `data-readonly`, `data-invalid` and `data-state` of `open` or `closed`. (zag: packages/machines/cascade-select/src/cascade-select.connect.ts)
- The label part is a native `label` with an `id`, `htmlFor` pointing at the hidden input id, `data-disabled`, `data-readonly` and `data-invalid`. (zag: packages/machines/cascade-select/src/cascade-select.connect.ts)
- The control part has an `id`, `data-disabled`, `data-focus`, `data-readonly`, `data-invalid` and `data-state` open/closed. (zag: packages/machines/cascade-select/src/cascade-select.connect.ts)
- The trigger part is a `button` with `type="button"`, `role="combobox"`, `aria-controls` the content id, `aria-expanded`, `aria-haspopup="listbox"`, `aria-labelledby` the label id, the native `disabled` attribute, plus `data-state`, `data-disabled`, `data-readonly`, `data-invalid`, `data-focus`, `data-placement`, `data-side` and `data-placeholder-shown` when nothing is selected. (zag: packages/machines/cascade-select/src/cascade-select.connect.ts)
- The clear-trigger part is a `button` with `type="button"`, a hardcoded `aria-label="Clear value"`, `hidden` whenever there are no selected values, the native `disabled` attribute, and `data-disabled`/`data-readonly`/`data-invalid`. (zag: packages/machines/cascade-select/src/cascade-select.connect.ts)
- The content part has `role="listbox"`, `aria-labelledby` the label id, `aria-activedescendant` plus a mirrored `data-activedescendant` for the highlighted path's item id, `data-state` open/closed, `aria-multiselectable` from the `multiple` prop, `aria-required` from `required`, `aria-readonly` from `readOnly`, `hidden` while closed and `tabIndex={0}`. (zag: packages/machines/cascade-select/src/cascade-select.connect.ts)
- Each list (column) part has an `id` derived from its owning value, `role="group"`, `data-depth` and `aria-level` set to the list's depth, so columns are addressable by depth. (zag: packages/machines/cascade-select/src/cascade-select.connect.ts)
- The indicator part has an `id`, `aria-hidden="true"`, `data-state` open/closed, `data-disabled`, `data-readonly` and `data-invalid`. (zag: packages/machines/cascade-select/src/cascade-select.connect.ts)
- Each item has `role="treeitem"` (not `option`), an `id` from its value path, `aria-haspopup="menu"` only for branch nodes, `aria-expanded` reflecting whether a branch is the highlighted path (and `false` for leaves), `aria-controls` and `aria-owns` pointing at its child list id for branches, and `aria-disabled`. (zag: packages/machines/cascade-select/src/cascade-select.connect.ts)
- Each item also carries `data-value` (the stringified value path), `data-disabled`, `data-highlighted`, `data-selected`, `data-depth`, `data-state` checked/unchecked, `data-type` of `branch` or `leaf`, and `data-index-path` with the stringified index path. (zag: packages/machines/cascade-select/src/cascade-select.connect.ts)
- The item-text part has `data-value` (the node's own value), `data-highlighted`, `data-state` checked/unchecked and `data-disabled`. (zag: packages/machines/cascade-select/src/cascade-select.connect.ts)
- The item-indicator part has `data-value`, `data-highlighted`, `data-type` branch/leaf, `data-state` checked/unchecked and is `hidden` unless the item is selected. (zag: packages/machines/cascade-select/src/cascade-select.connect.ts)
- The value-text part has `data-disabled`, `data-invalid` and `data-focus`. (zag: packages/machines/cascade-select/src/cascade-select.connect.ts)
- The positioner part has an `id` and the same popper floating inline styles as select, including `transform: translate3d(var(--x), var(--y), 0)`, `z-index: var(--z-index)`, and `width: var(--reference-width)` / `max-width: var(--available-width)` / `max-height: var(--available-height)` under `sameWidth` and `fitViewport`. (zag: packages/machines/cascade-select/src/cascade-select.connect.ts; zag: packages/utilities/popper/src/get-styles.ts)
- Given `allowParentSelection`, `multiple` and `closeOnSelect=false`, when `Africa` and then `Asia` are clicked, then each of those items shows its item-indicator, while the disabled `Antarctica` continent never shows one. (zag: e2e/cascade-select.e2e.ts: "navigation and lists > should show item indicators for parent items")
- Given the open dropdown, then the disabled `Antarctica` item has both a `data-disabled` attribute and `aria-disabled="true"`. (zag: e2e/cascade-select.e2e.ts: "disabled items > should visually indicate disabled items")

### Keyboard

- Given the focused trigger, when Enter opens the dropdown and ArrowDown, ArrowDown, ArrowUp are pressed, then the highlight moves `Asia`, `Europe`, back to `Asia` within the first column. (zag: e2e/cascade-select.e2e.ts: "keyboard navigation > should open dropdown with Enter and navigate with arrows")
- Given the dropdown open with `Asia` highlighted, when ArrowRight is pressed, then the depth-1 list becomes visible and its first item `Afghanistan` is highlighted. (zag: e2e/cascade-select.e2e.ts: "keyboard navigation > should navigate into child list with ArrowRight")
- Given the highlight moved into Asia's child list, when ArrowLeft is pressed, then the highlight returns to the parent item `Asia`. (zag: e2e/cascade-select.e2e.ts: "keyboard navigation > should navigate back to parent list with ArrowLeft")
- Given the dropdown open and the highlight driven down into `Asia / Afghanistan`, when Enter is pressed on the first state, then the trigger reads `Asia / Afghanistan / Badakhshān` and the dropdown closes because a leaf was selected. (zag: e2e/cascade-select.e2e.ts: "keyboard navigation > should select item with Enter")
- Given the dropdown opened from the trigger with `Africa` highlighted, when End and Home are pressed in the continent column, then the highlight goes to `South America` and back to `Africa`; after ArrowRight into Africa, End and Home move within that column only, giving `Zimbabwe` and `Algeria`. (zag: e2e/cascade-select.e2e.ts: "keyboard navigation > should navigate with Home and End keys")
- Given the highlight inside Asia's country column, when End then Home are pressed, then `Yemen` and then `Afghanistan` are highlighted and each is scrolled inside the content viewport. (zag: e2e/cascade-select.e2e.ts: "keyboard navigation > should scroll highlighted items into view during keyboard navigation")
- Given the default `allowParentSelection=false`, when Enter is pressed on the branch item `Asia`, then the trigger still reads `Select a location`; after two ArrowRight presses into a leaf, Enter sets the trigger to `Asia / Afghanistan / Badakhshān` and closes the dropdown. (zag: e2e/cascade-select.e2e.ts: "advanced selection behavior > keyboard selection behavior > should select items with Enter key respecting parent selection rules")
- Given `allowParentSelection` enabled, when Enter is pressed on the highlighted branch `Asia`, then the trigger reads `Asia`. (zag: e2e/cascade-select.e2e.ts: "advanced selection behavior > keyboard selection behavior > should allow keyboard selection of parents when enabled")
