- `goto(type)` - navigates to `/toast/stacked` or `/toast/overlap`.

- `seeToastArePaused()` - iterates every `role=status` and asserts `data-paused=""`.

### e2e/models/tour.model.ts
- `goto()` - navigates to `/tour/basic`.
- `checkSelection()` - reads `window.getSelection().toString()` for the preventInteraction cases.
- `content` / `title` / `target` / `spotlight` - locators for the content part, the title inside it, the element carrying `[data-tour-highlighted]`, and the spotlight part.

### e2e/models/menu.model.ts
- `checkAccessibility()` - runs axe over `main` instead of the root part, because the menu content is portalled.

- `getItem(text)` - locator for an `[data-part=item]` containing that text.

### e2e/models/tabs.model.ts
- `checkAccessibility()` - runs the axe helper over the page, overriding the base method with no selector argument so it always scans `[data-part=root]`.
- `goto()` - navigates to `/tabs/basic`.
- `getTabTrigger(id)` - private locator for `[data-testid="<id>-tab"]`.
- `getTabContent(id)` - private locator for `[data-testid="<id>-tab-panel"]`.
- `getIndicator()` - private locator for `[data-scope='tabs'][data-part='indicator']`, reading the indicator by scope and part rather than a test id.
- `clickTab(id)` - clicks the trigger for that tab id.
- `seeTabContent(id)` - asserts that tab's panel is visible.
- `dontSeeTabContent(id)` - asserts that tab's panel is not visible.
- `seeTabIsFocused(id)` - asserts that tab's trigger is the focused element.
- `getIndicatorRect()` - returns the indicator's bounding box extended with midX, midY, maxX and maxY, throwing if the element is not rendered.
- `modifyTabContent(id, newContent)` - evaluates in the page to replace the text of the first `<p>` inside that tab's panel, used to force a layout change.
- `modifyTabLabel(id, newLabel)` - evaluates in the page to replace the trigger's text content, used to change a tab's width at runtime.
- `getTabRect(id)` - returns the trigger's bounding box with the same midpoint and max extensions.
- `seeIndicatorAlignedWithTab(tabId)` - asserts both rects exist and that the indicator's x is within 2px of the tab's x.
- `seeIndicatorMovedWithTab(tabId, beforeTab, beforeIndicator)` - re-measures the tab and indicator, and only if the tab's x actually changed asserts the indicator's x is within 2px of the tab's new x, so it silently passes when nothing moved.
- `waitForIndicatorToUpdate(tabId)` - polls in the page until the indicator's x is within 2px of the tab's x, then awaits every running animation on the indicator via `getAnimations()`.

- `goto()` - navigates to `/tree-view/basic`.

- `seeAllBranchesAreCollapsed()` - asserts the tree contains zero `[role="treeitem"][aria-expanded="true"]` elements.
- `seeAllBranchesAreExpanded()` - asserts the tree contains zero `[role="treeitem"][aria-expanded="false"]` elements.

- `seeItemIsTabbable(name)` - asserts that tree item has `tabindex="0"`.

### e2e/models/select.model.ts
- `constructor(page)` - stores the Playwright page and inherits the base `Model` console/pageerror capture.
- `checkAccessibility()` - runs `a11y(page, ".select")`, an axe scan scoped to the example's `.select` container with `color-contrast` disabled.
- `goto(url = "/select/basic")` - navigates to the select example route.
- `trigger` (private getter) - locator for `[data-scope=select][data-part=trigger]`.
- `content` (private getter) - locator for `[data-scope=select][data-part=content]`.
- `label` (private getter) - locator for `[data-scope=select][data-part=label]`.
- `clearTrigger` (private getter) - locator for `[data-scope=select][data-part=clear-trigger]`.
- `getItem(text)` - locator for `[data-part=item]` filtered by `hasText`, so it is a substring match on the item.
- `highlightedItem` (getter) - locator for `[data-part=item][data-highlighted]`.
- `type(input)` - `pressSequentially(input)` on the content part, typing one character at a time to drive typeahead.
- `focusTrigger()` - calls `.focus()` on the trigger directly.
- `clickLabel()` - clicks the label part.
- `pointerDownTrigger()` - dispatches a raw `pointerdown` with `pointerType: "mouse"`, `button: 0` on the trigger via the `pointer` helper.
- `clickTrigger()` - clicks the trigger.
- `clickClearTrigger()` - clicks the clear-trigger part.
- `clickItem(text)` - clicks the item matched by text.
- `hoverItem(text)` - hovers the item matched by text.
- `pointerUpItem(text)` - dispatches a raw `pointerup` on the item.
- `hoverOut()` - moves the mouse to (0, 0).
- `seeTriggerIsFocused()` - asserts the trigger `toBeFocused`.
- `seeTriggerHasText(text)` - asserts the trigger `toContainText(text)`.
- `seeDropdown()` - asserts the content part is visible.
- `dontSeeDropdown()` - asserts the content part is not visible.
- `seeDropdownIsFocused()` - asserts the content part itself has DOM focus.
- `seeItemIsHighlighted(text)` - asserts that item has `data-highlighted=""`.
- `dontSeeHighlightedItem()` - asserts no `[data-part=item][data-highlighted]` element is visible.
- `seeItemIsChecked(text)` - asserts that item has `data-state="checked"`.
- `seeItemInViewport(text)` - computes bounding boxes with `isInViewport(content, item)` and asserts the item is fully inside the content viewport.
- `autofill(value)` - in-page script that finds `[data-scope='select'] select[aria-hidden]`, throws `Hidden select not found` if absent, sets its `value` and dispatches a bubbling `change` event, simulating browser autofill.

### e2e/models/listbox.model.ts
- `constructor(page)` - stores the page and inherits the base `Model`.
- `checkAccessibility()` - runs `a11y(page)` with the default `[data-part=root]` include selector.
- `goto(url = "/listbox/basic")` - navigates to the listbox example route.
- `label` (getter) - locator for `[data-scope=listbox][data-part=label]`.
- `input` (getter) - locator for `[data-scope=listbox][data-part=input]`.
- `getItem(text)` - locator for `[data-scope=listbox][data-part=item]` filtered by `hasText`.
- `content` (getter) - locator for `[data-scope=listbox][data-part=content]`.
- `tabToContent()` - force-clicks `main.listbox` at position (300, 30), presses Tab, and asserts the content part is focused; the canonical "enter the widget" gesture.
- `typeSequentially(value)` - `pressSequentially` on the input part.
- `clickItem(value)` - clicks the item matched by text.
- `seeItemIsHighlighted(value)` - asserts that item has `data-highlighted=""`.
- `seeNoItemIsHighlighted()` - asserts the list of `[data-highlighted]` descendants of content has length 0.
- `seeItemIsSelected(value)` - asserts that item has `data-selected=""`.
- `seeNoItemIsSelected()` - asserts the list of `[data-selected]` descendants of content has length 0.
- `seeItemInViewport(text)` - asserts via `isInViewport(content, item)` that the item is fully inside the content viewport.

### e2e/models/cascade-select.model.ts
- `constructor(page)` - stores the page and inherits the base `Model`.
- `checkAccessibility()` - runs `a11y(page, ".cascade-select")`, an axe scan scoped to the example container.
- `goto(url = "/cascade-select/basic")` - navigates to the cascade-select example route.
- `trigger` (private getter) - locator for `[data-scope=cascade-select][data-part=trigger]`.
- `content` (private getter) - locator for `[data-scope=cascade-select][data-part=content]`.
- `label` (private getter) - locator for `[data-scope=cascade-select][data-part=label]`.
- `clearTrigger` (private getter) - locator for `[data-scope=cascade-select][data-part=clear-trigger]`.
- `getItem(text)` - locator for `[data-part=item]` filtered to those containing a `[data-part=item-text]` whose text matches `^text$`, an exact match so `Africa` cannot match `South Africa`.
- `getList(depth)` - locator for `[data-part=list][data-depth="<depth>"]`, addressing one cascade column.
- `highlightedItems` (getter) - locator for all `[data-part=item][data-highlighted]`.
- `selectedItems` (getter) - locator for all `[data-part=item][data-state='checked']`.
- `focusTrigger()` - calls `.focus()` on the trigger.
- `clickLabel()` - clicks the label part.
- `clickTrigger()` - clicks the trigger.
- `clickTriggerForced()` - clicks the trigger with `{ force: true }`, used to attempt interaction with a disabled trigger.
- `clickClearTrigger()` - clicks the clear-trigger part.
- `clickItem(text)` - clicks the exactly matched item.
- `hoverItem(text)` - hovers the exactly matched item.
- `hoverOut()` - hovers the content part at position (0, 0), moving the pointer off the item but staying inside the popup, which is what exercises the grace area.
- `seeTriggerIsFocused()` - asserts the trigger `toBeFocused`.
- `seeTriggerHasText(text)` - asserts the trigger `toContainText(text)`.
- `seeDropdown()` / `dontSeeDropdown()` - assert the content part is or is not visible.
- `seeItemIsHighlighted(text)` - asserts the item has a `data-highlighted` attribute (presence only, no value check).
- `dontSeeHighlightedItems()` - asserts `[data-part=item][data-highlighted]` has count 0.
- `seeItemInViewport(text)` - asserts via `isInViewport(content, item)` that the item is inside the content viewport.
- `seeList(depth)` / `dontSeeList(depth)` - assert the column at that `data-depth` is or is not visible.
- `seeItemHasIndicator(text)` / `dontSeeItemHasIndicator(text)` - assert the item's nested `[data-part=item-indicator]` is or is not visible.
- `seeHighlightedItemsCount(count)` - asserts the number of highlighted items, used to check how much of the path is highlighted.
- `seeSelectedItemsCount(count)` - asserts the number of items with `data-state="checked"`.
- `seeClearTrigger()` / `dontSeeClearTrigger()` - assert the clear-trigger part is or is not visible.

### e2e/models/combobox.model.ts
- `goto(url = "/combobox/basic")` - navigates to a combobox example (basic, form, multiple, async, controlled-ignore, external-value-change).
- `input` / `trigger` / `clearTrigger` / `content` - private locators for those parts.
- `items` - locator for `[data-part=item]:not([data-disabled])`, so counts ignore disabled options.
- `getItem(text)` - locator for an item containing that text.
- `highlightedItem` - locator for `[data-part=item][data-highlighted]`.
- `type(input)` - presses characters sequentially into the input.
- `clickInput()` - force-clicks the input (force is needed because the trigger may overlap it).
- `clickTrigger()` / `clickClearTrigger()` - clicks the arrow or clear button.
- `hoverItem(text)` / `clickItem(text)` / `focusInput()` - other interactions.
- `seeDropdown()` / `dontSeeDropdown()` - content visibility.
- `seeNumberOfItems(count)` - asserts the count of enabled items.
- `seeItemIsHighlighted(text)` - asserts `data-highlighted=""`.
- `seeItemIsChecked(text)` / `seeItemIsNotChecked(text)` - asserts `data-state="checked"` presence or absence.
- `seeItemInViewport(text)` - polls the shared `isInViewport` helper against the content box, proving scroll-into-view.
- `seeInputHasValue(value)` / `seeInputIsFocused()` - input assertions.
- `dontSeeHighlightedItem()` - asserts zero highlighted items.
- `valueText` / `seeValueText(text)` / `dontSeeValueText()` - the `value-text` testid element, used by the multiple-selection example.
- `valueChangeText` / `seeOnValueChangeItems(text)` / `seeOnValueChangeItemsIsEmpty()` - the `on-value-change-items` testid element; empty is expressed as the text "N/A".
- `submitCount` / `lastSubmit` / `seeSubmitCount(count)` / `seeLastSubmit(value)` - form example readouts used to prove whether Enter submitted.

### e2e/models/carousel.model.ts
- `goto(url = "/carousel/basic")` - navigates to the carousel example.
- `checkAccessibility(selector?)` - axe over the given selector.
- `getItem(index)` / `getIndicator(index)` - nth item and indicator parts.
- `prevTrigger` / `nextTrigger` / `autoplayTrigger` / `carousel` - locators for the controls and the item-group scroll container.
- `clickPrevTrigger()` / `clickNextTrigger()` / `clickAutoplayTrigger()` / `clickIndicator(index)` / `focusIndicator(index)` - interactions.
- `swipeCarousel(direction, distance, duration, release)` - delegates to the shared `mouseSwipe` helper, optionally leaving the button held down so a drag can be inspected mid-gesture.
- `holdDrag(ms)` - waits while the pointer is still down, used to give the machine time to register a drag.
- `releaseDrag()` - releases the mouse button.
- `wheelCarousel(deltaX, deltaY)` - centers the mouse over the carousel and dispatches a wheel event.
- `waitForScrollSettle(timeout = 1500)` - in-page helper that awaits the native `scrollend` event when available and otherwise polls `scrollLeft`/`scrollTop` (choosing the axis from `data-orientation`) until three consecutive frames differ by less than 0.5px.
- `clickScrollToButton(index)` - clicks the example's "Scroll to N" button, exercising the imperative API.
- `seeAutoplayIsOn()` / `seeAutoplayIsOff()` - asserts the autoplay trigger text is "Stop" or "Play".
- `seeNumOfItems(count)` - asserts the item count.
- `seeItemInView(index)` / `dontSeeItemInView(index)` - asserts `data-inview` presence or absence.
- `seePrevTriggerIsDisabled()` / `seePrevTriggerIsEnabled()` / `seeNextTriggerIsDisabled()` / `seeNextTriggerIsEnabled()` - boundary assertions on the controls.
- `seeIndicatorIsActive(index)` / `seeIndicatorIsInactive(index)` - asserts `data-current` presence or absence.

### e2e/models/datepicker.model.ts
- `checkAccessibility()` - runs axe over the picker.
- `getDate({ day, month, year })` - builds a date relative to today and returns both the date object and its formatted string, so specs can assert locale-formatted values without hardcoding them.
- `goto(url = "/date-picker/basic")` - navigates to one of the many date-picker examples (basic, min-max, range, inline, month, year, month-range, year-range, month-inline, year-inline, multi-month, open-control, custom-calendar).
- `trigger` / `content` / `table` / `monthSelect` / `yearSelect` / `prevTrigger` / `nextTrigger` / `clearTrigger` - scoped part locators.
- `getInput(index = 0)` - the nth input, so range pickers can address start and end separately.
- `tableForView(view)` - the table filtered by `data-view` of day, month or year.
- `todayCell` - the `data-today` cell trigger excluding `data-outside-range`, because a multi-month calendar can render today twice.
- `firstDayCell` / `lastDayCell` - cells matching the ISO start and end of the current month, excluding spillover cells.
- `notTodayCell` - a neighbouring day (tomorrow when today is the 1st, otherwise yesterday), used for "clicking should not change the value" assertions.
- `getViewCell(view, value)` - private locator matching a cell trigger for a view by its rendered text.
- `getNextDayCell({ current, step = 1 })` / `getPrevDayCell(...)` - the cell for today (or a given ISO date) plus or minus a step, used for arrow-key assertions including the seven-day week step.
- `getDayCell(value)` / `getMonthCell(value)` / `getYearCell(value)` - cells by rendered text for each view.
- `clickTrigger()` / `clickTodayCell()` / `clickDayCell(value)` / `clickClearTrigger()` - interactions.
- `type(value, index = 0)` - presses characters sequentially into the nth input.
- `focusInput(index)` / `selectInput(index)` - focuses or selects all text in the nth input.
- `clearInput(index)` - focuses, selects all with ControlOrMeta+A and presses Backspace.
- `selectMonth(value)` - selects an option on the month-select element.
- `seeContent()` / `dontSeeContent()` - calendar visibility.
- `waitForCalendarRender()` - waits for the table to be visible and then 100ms, to let the grid settle.
- `getCurrentMonthDayCells()` - all day cell triggers excluding outside-range spillover.
- `clickOutsideToBlur()` - clicks `main` at (10,10), the reliable blur gesture used by the min-max and range specs.
- `seeTodayCellIsFocused()` / `seePrevDayCellIsFocused(opts)` / `seeNextDayCellIsFocused(opts)` / `seeFirstDayCellIsFocused()` / `seeLastDayCellIsFocused()` - focus assertions on the derived cells.
- `seeInputHasValue(value, index)` / `seeInputIsFocused(index)` / `seeInputIsNotFocused(index)` - per-input assertions.
- `seeSelectedValue(value)` / `seeFocusedValue(value)` - asserts the example's `.date-output` element contains "Selected: <value>" or "Focused: <value>".
- `cellsForView(view)` / `getCellByValue(view, value)` - private locators by `data-view` and `data-value`.
- `getVisibleCellValues(view)` - in-page evaluation returning the `data-value` numbers of cells whose `offsetParent` is non-null, so hidden views are excluded.
- `getCellValuesWithAttr(view, attr)` - in-page evaluation returning the values of cells carrying a given attribute, which is how hover-range bands are asserted as exact arrays.
- `getYearCellByValue(year)` / `getVisibleYears()` / `clickYearCell(year)` / `hoverYearCell(year)` / `focusFirstYearCell()` / `clickNextDecade()` - year-view helpers.
- `seeYearCellIsFocused(year)` / `seeYearCellIsDisabled(year)` / `dontSeeYearCellIsDisabled(year)` / `seeYearCellIsOutsideRange(year)` / `seeNoDisabledYearCells()` / `seeYearsInHoverRange(years)` - year-view assertions, the last two comparing whole arrays of cell values.
- `getMonthCellByValue(month)` / `getVisibleMonths()` / `clickMonthCell(month)` / `hoverMonthCell(month)` / `focusFirstMonthCell()` / `clickNextYear()` - month-view helpers.
- `seeMonthCellIsFocused(month)` / `seeMonthCellIsDisabled(month)` / `dontSeeMonthCellIsDisabled(month)` / `seeNoDisabledMonthCells()` / `seeMonthsInHoverRange(months)` - month-view assertions.
- `getDayCellByValue(value)` / `seeDayCellIsFocused(value)` - day cells addressed by ISO value rather than rendered text, used by the range specs.

### e2e/models/date-input.model.ts
- `goto(url = "/date-input/basic")` - navigates to a date-input example (basic, range, hour-cycle, timezone, min-max).
- `checkAccessibility(selector?, disableRules?)` - axe over the given selector with optional rule exclusions.
- `root` / `label` / `control` - scoped part locators.
- `getSegmentGroup(index?)` - the segment-group part, optionally the nth one so a range input's two groups can be addressed separately.
- `getEditableSegments()` - all segments carrying `data-editable`, which excludes literals and read-only segments such as timeZoneName.
- `getSegment(type)` - a segment by `data-type` (month, day, year, hour, minute, second, dayPeriod, era, timeZoneName, literal).
- `output` - the example's `.date-output` element, which renders "Selected:", "Placeholder:" and "Editing:" lines.
- `getSegmentInGroup(type, groupIndex)` - a segment of that type inside one group.
- `getSegmentNth(type, index = 0)` - the nth segment of a type across the whole input.
- `focusFirstSegment()` - clicks the first editable segment.
- `focusSegment(type)` - clicks a segment by type.
- `clickOutsideToBlur()` - clicks `main` at (10,10) to blur the control, the gesture that triggers commit-on-blur clamping.
- `paste(text)` - dispatches a synthetic `ClipboardEvent` with a DataTransfer payload on the active element, since segments are contenteditable rather than inputs.
- `seeSegmentFocused(type)` / `seeSegmentInGroupFocused(type, groupIndex?)` - focus assertions per segment and per group.
- `seeSegmentText(type, text)` - asserts a segment's rendered text, which is how leading-zero and locale formatting are checked.
- `seeSegmentHasCount(type, count)` - asserts how many segments of a type exist, used to prove dayPeriod and timeZoneName appear or disappear.
- `seeSegmentIsPlaceholder(type)` / `seeSegmentIsNotPlaceholder(type)` / `seeSegmentInGroupIsPlaceholder(type, index?)` - assertions on `data-placeholder-shown`.
- `seeSelectedValue(value)` - asserts the output contains "Selected: <value>", treating an empty value as "-".
- `seePlaceholderValue(value)` - asserts the output contains "Placeholder: <value>", which is how the placeholder-stability regressions are pinned.
- `seeControlFocused()` / `seeControlNotFocused()` - assertions on the control's `data-focus`.
- `seeSegmentGroupFocused(groupIndex)` / `seeSegmentGroupNotFocused(groupIndex)` - assertions on a group's `data-focus`.
- `seeEditingValue(value)` / `seeNoEditingValue()` - asserts the output's "Editing:" line, exposing the internal editing accumulator that holds partial segment entry.

### e2e/models/color-picker.model.ts
- `goto()` / `gotoInline()` - navigates to `/color-picker/basic` or `/color-picker/inline`.
- `trigger` / `content` - private locators for those parts.
- `hexInput` / `alphaInput` - the channel inputs inside the control, addressed by `[data-channel=hex]` and `[data-channel=alpha]`.
- `areaThumb` / `area` - the 2D area and its thumb.
- `channelInput(channel)` / `channelThumb(channel)` / `channelSlider(channel)` - locators filtered by `data-channel`, covering red, green, blue, alpha, hue, saturation, lightness and brightness.
- `swatchTriggers` / `resetButton` / `valueText` - the swatch triggers, the form's Reset button and the `value-text` testid element.
- `type(value)` - fills the hex input.
- `seeHexInputHasValue(value)` / `typeInAlphaInput(value)` / `seeAlphaInputHasValue(value)` - hex and alpha input helpers.
- `seeValueText(value)` - asserts the rendered value text contains the expected color string.
- `clickTrigger()` / `seeColorPicker()` / `dontSeeColorPicker()` / `seeTriggerIsFocused()` - open, close and focus assertions.
- `seeAreaThumbIsFocused()` / `seeChannelThumbIsFocused(channel)` - focus assertions per thumb.
- `seeAreaThumbIsDisabled()` / `seeChannelThumbIsDisabled(channel)` - asserts `aria-disabled="true"`.
- `clickFirstSwatch()` / `clickResetButton()` / `clickChannelSlider(channel)` - interactions; clicking a slider lands at its center, which is why the hue test expects 180 and the alpha test 0.5.
- `getAreaBounds()` - the area's rect with derived mid and max points.
- `dragAreaToPoint(point)` - presses at the area thumb's center, moves to the given page point in 10 steps and releases, used to prove a scrub ending outside the picker does not dismiss it.

### e2e/models/image-cropper.model.ts
- `goto(url = "/image-cropper/basic")` - navigates to basic, fixed or circle examples.
- `checkAccessibility()` - axe over the cropper.
- `viewport` / `image` / `selection` / `overlay` - scoped part locators.
- `zoomSlider` / `rotationSlider` / `flipHorizontalCheckbox` / `flipVerticalCheckbox` / `toggleHorizontalFlipButton` / `toggleVerticalFlipButton` / `resetFlipButton` - the example's control widgets.
- `getHandle(position)` - the resize handle for one of the eight positions via `data-position`.
- `getSelectionRect()` / `getViewportRect()` / `getViewportSize()` - measured geometry.
- `getImageTransform()` - reads the image's computed `transform` matrix string.
- `getNaturalImageScale()` - the ratio between the image's natural size and its rendered size, used to verify export pixel dimensions.
- `getRotationFromMatrix(transform)` / `getScaleFromMatrix(transform)` / `getTranslateFromMatrix(transform)` - decode rotation, scale and translation out of the CSS matrix, which is how zoom, rotate and pan are asserted numerically.
- `getFlipState()` - reads the reported horizontal and vertical flip flags.
- `dragSelection(dx, dy)` - presses inside the selection and drags it by a delta.
- `dragHandle(position, dx, dy, { shift })` - drags a named handle by a delta, optionally holding Shift to lock the aspect ratio.
- `panImage(dx, dy)` - drags the overlay to pan the image beneath a fixed crop.
- `setFlipCheckbox(axis, checked)` / `toggleFlip(axis)` / `resetFlip()` - flip controls through the checkbox and the action buttons.
- `zoomWithWheel(deltaY, point?)` - dispatches a wheel event over the viewport, negative deltas zooming in.
- `seeSelectionPosition(x, y)` / `seeSelectionSize(width, height)` - exact geometry assertions.
- `seeSelectionVisible()` / `seeImageVisible()` - visibility assertions.
- `waitForImageLoad()` - waits for the image to report ready before any measurement.
- `focusSelection()` - focuses the selection, the single focusable element of the widget.
- `pressKeyWithModifiers(key, { alt, shift, ctrl, meta })` - holds the requested modifiers around a key press, used for the resize and large-step assertions.
- `resizeHandleSelect` / `resizeStepInput` / `growButton` / `shrinkButton` - the example's resize-API controls.
- `selectResizeHandle(position)` / `setResizeStep(step)` / `clickGrow()` / `clickShrink()` - drive `api.resizeCrop` through those controls.
- `resizeViewport(width, height)` - changes the viewport element's size to test crop rescaling.
